items.description: App for IPhone and iPod touch that lets you upload a camera image, or a picture from the Image Library or from your Facebook photo albums, and find out what celebrities you and your friends look like. The app looks ONLY at your face features, not skin color or hair color. Share the results, morph your face with your twin, learn about the celebrities, buy celebrity stuff and find other people who look like your twin.
Online passport and visa photo service that provides guaranteed government compliance based on sophisticated biometrics.
The new intelligent property search engine for London. This tool uses Zoopla to aggregate and display search results.
Allows Box.net users to share content in their Box accounts to FriendFeed.
Earth Album is a google maps and YouTube mash-up that allows you to tour the videospace of the world via YouTube tags.
Map of Bastille Day Event Locations in the United States.
Burger Joints shows the most tweeted burger chain in towns across the United States. Type in your city or area and see what pops up.
An Adobe Flash and Adobe AIR application that uses color themes from kuler to draw patterns. It also draws at dimensions defined by the user which can be used for wallpapers etc.
Local Alerts, Local News, Yahoo Traffic, Google Maps, NOAA Weather mashup. Alert mashup includes CERT, earthquakes, tsunamis, Avian flu...
Tourism in Peru. Guide to travel agencies, tourist services, cities, tours, history, adventure, nature, gastronomy, pictures, and videos of Peru.

Displays different bus routes and timetables in Darwin, Australia. View all bus stops, either in real time or by using the timeline, the latest real-time traffic information and the StreetView of each bus stop.
Create your own Google Maps with photos, comments, directions.
Track tweets about Michael Jackson from Western and Eastern United States, Europe,India, Australia.

Display your Google Latitude location and location history. Guest and public access options control who can view your location. Dead Zone keeps your location from being displayed when you are within X miles of the location you specify.
Uses Google Maps & Places API to make viewing nearby search results easy.
A cost-effective app to mass notify your team using SMS. It uses your Google Contacts to help you quickly send notifications without the hassle of managing yet another address book of contacts.
The Mashup allows you to search for Adobe Flex developer jobs based on your Zip code. Also you can SMS a job posting to your cell phone.

Rebate Bus makes utility energy efficiency incentives easy. It hooks into eCommerce and distributor websites to integrate the incentives into the purchase experience. Rebate Bus is a utility rebate expert. They can file applications on your behalf, deliver instant incentives on your website and give you access to their rebate API
Noodler makes vehicle comparison fun! See similarities and differences at a glance. Data from Edmunds.com, the highly reputable research site.
View freelance jobs from Indeed.
Returns an RSS feed from Google containing the latest news about your favourite artists, as listed in your Last.fm profile.
Geolocates and displays the RSS feed you enter or choose from a selection (Reuters, AP, AFP, All together, Top news from all countries).
